lines.text: This is the decontamination zone. You need to find the access card.
lines.speaker: NONO

lines.text: Then, cross the corridor to enter the interior of the research facility.
lines.speaker: NONO

lines.text: What is going on with those robots with the red glowing eyes?
lines.speaker: Player

lines.text: They are the rogue robots. Watch out for them, and the slime on the ground!
lines.speaker: NONO

lines.text: How should I find the access card?
lines.speaker: Player

lines.text: FOLLOW ME. I will guide your way.
lines.speaker: NONO
